messages.subject: Palestinian Territories in the Rworldmap?
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I've noticed that the countryExData data frame does not include the Palestinian Territories. Is there any way known of here to find an SPDF and a data frame which includes it? I suppose that I am going to make my own data frame anyway, but I wouldn't know how to join it to the shape files, etc.

I would appreciate your advice.

Cheers,

Abed
